This is very helpful! The key insight is from the documentation: [cite: concepts/workloads/pods/probes#when-should-you-use-a-readiness-probe-0] "When your app has a strict dependency on back-end services, you can implement both a liveness and a readiness probe. The liveness probe passes when the app itself is healthy, but the readiness probe additionally checks that each required back-end service is available. This helps you avoid directing traffic to Pods that can only respond with error messages."

The issue appears to be that storefront-web 3.0 has a dependency on the pricing-api (which was mentioned in the ticket as carrying a pricing fix), but the readiness probe may not be checking if the pricing-api is available. Let me search for information about inter-service dependencies.
